title: Writ field merge rule declarations (v1)
description: Declarative field merge rule declarations: strategies, keys, lattices, and normalization attributes per (op_type, field) tuple. Normative text: spec/fold.md. additionalProperties is deliberately never false: unknown fields are preserved and ignored.

op_type.description: Operation type to which this rule applies.

op_version.description: Operation version to which this rule applies.

field.description: Name of the field in the operation body.

strategy.description: Closed catalogue merge strategy from spec/fold.md.

key.description: Ordered list of key components for keyed-lww strategy.

lattice.description: Ordered elements of the semilattice for lattice strategy.

value.description: Normalization algorithm applied to scalar values.

items.description: Normalization algorithm applied to collection elements/items.

key.description: Key components normalized per algorithm (e.g. as person).
